title: •Maneuver Check
caption: •Maneuver Check (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Starships may not move the turn they are deployed (or carried) to Death Star. Once per game, if Alderaan ‘blown away,’ may target a system. Unless opponent has a capital (or {episode1}) starship there, objectives treat target as a Subjugated planet. {alter}
lore: “Luke, at that speed will you be able to pull out in time?”
